messages:
maria: Hey — customer reports a sudden 403 in the Console when switching to project 'prod-data'. API calls to `GET /v1/projects/prod-data` return 403 as well. They were moved org->org two nights ago via admin UI.
devon: Are they using SSO/SCIM? Any group rename recently?
maria: Yes Okta + SCIM. Support says the move completed at 2026-03-15 22:40 UTC. Other projects are fine, only this project shows all action buttons greyed out.
sam: Can you paste the member list for that project (admin endpoint)? look for missing role bindings.
maria: Snippet from the API: "members": [{"id":"U123","roles":["viewer"]},{"id":"U999","roles":[]}] — one service principal lost roles.
aj: That pattern matches a SCIM group rename we saw last quarter; SCIM pushed an empty role attr so group -> role mapping became a no-op.
maria: Customer tried re-sync in Okta, no immediate change.
devon: Quick checks: 1) Confirm Okta group still maps to a Redwood role in SCIM app config; 2) Check `authz` logs for `role-claim-mapping` errors; 3) If urgent, add a temp project-admin via admin API to unblock.
maria: authz log excerpt: `2026-03-16T07:12:03Z authz: principal U999 missing role for project prod-data (mapping_lookup: failure)`
support-bot: Incident INC-5543 created, severity P2 — escalated to eng-access. ETA 4h.
devon: Workaround that helped another customer: create a one-off SCIM mapping that sets the role attribute explicitly, trigger a SCIM push, then remove the placeholder mapping after roles repopulate. Not ideal but unblocks.
aj: Repro steps for eng: 1) simulate org transfer via `POST /internal/admin/orgs/transfer` (internal), 2) after transfer attempt console switch as affected user, 3) observe `403` and check `authz` service logs for `missing role for principal`.
maria: Customer approved admin API add as immediate fix. I'll run: `POST /internal/admin/projects/prod-data/members` body { "user_id": "U999", "roles": ["project-admin"] } and confirm.
devon: I'll open a product ticket to detect SCIM group rename drift and add a health check. @product-lead can you take a look?
product-lead: Will review, priority looks high for cross-org transfer reliability.
maria: Thanks all — I'll post case 987654 updates here when fixed. :thumbsup:
